summary: DeFi Technologies filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Q1 2026 earnings press release. The release reported revenue of $11.2 million, net income of $4.9 million, cash and stablecoins of $103.4 million, digital asset treasury of $23.5 million, and a venture portfolio of $29.1 million. It also noted improved working capital to $47.3 million from negative $5.1 million. No transaction, offer, or special situation is announced; this is a routine financial update for a foreign private issuer.
